items.summary: Company plans to add nearly 200 rooms at its upcoming Taj Delhi airport property in Q1 FY28, against an earlier target of 70 rooms.

items.headline: ICE arrest at Seattle Airport prompts outcry from officials, politicians
items.summary: Masked federal agents confronted passengers on a jet bridge as they boarded an Alaska Airlines flight to Los Angeles, forcing a woman to the ground in a chaotic encounter captured on video

items.headline: Nitish Setu named after ex-Bihar CM inaugurated by PM Modi: All you need to know about the ₹ 4,280 crore bridge
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Nitish Setu, an extradosed cable-stayed bridge which is said to improve regional connectivity, ease traffic and boost the economic growth of the state.

items.headline: Transport sector outlook: Weak rail container volumes, subdued air traffic to weigh, JM Financial says
items.summary: JM Financial flags uneven recovery in India's transport sector, with weak rail container movement and subdued aviation demand despite strong EXIM growth.

items.headline: Delhi AQI remains 'poor' at 279, six stations record 'very poor' air
items.summary: Delhi's overall AQI stood at 279 at 7 am on Saturday, while Aiims and Chandni Chowk recorded readings above 360; the forecast points to a possible deterioration on Sunday

items.headline: India allows cut flower imports through Amritsar airport and Kandla seaport
items.summary: India has added Amritsar airport and Kandla seaport as entry points for cut flower imports, subject to mandatory plant quarantine inspection and certification.

items.headline: India must rethink aviation strategy to make airlines commercially viable
items.summary: Is there really a case for expanding Indian aviation when even a near-monopoly airline slips into losses at the slightest adverse turn in costs?

items.headline: Air India board holds meeting; discusses operational matters, fuel cost challenges: Sources
items.summary: The board of directors of loss-making Air India discussed various operational and financial matters, including issues related to rising fuel costs, during its meeting on Friday, according to sources.

items.headline: Threats, insults, settlements: How Jensen Huang made humiliation routine
items.summary: The Nvidia co-founder's belittling behavior toward employees goes back decades. It once led to a confidential settlement agreement with an executive who said Huang "terrorized" staff

items.headline: SpiceJet's ₹5,500 crore rescue bid runs into DGCA heat as fleet lies grounded
items.summary: The aviation regulator has questioned SpiceJet's ability to operate reliably, citing grounded aircraft, delays, cancellations and unpaid dues. The scrutiny comes as the airline seeks investments to fund a turnaround amid deep operational and financial stress.

items.headline: Parandur airport project: Madras HC orders notice to TN govt
items.summary: Bench of Chief Justice S A Dharmadhikari and Justice G Arul Murugan ordered notices to TNIDC, the Union Civil Aviation Ministry, and the AAI on a PIL by G Gouthaman

items.headline: Air India faces ₹22,000 crore loss: Tata Sons Board reviews airline's performance ahead of crucial meeting
items.summary: Tata Sons leaders reviewed Air India’s financial and operational challenges ahead of a board meeting. The airline lost more than ₹22,000 crore in FY2025-26, with fuel costs, airspace restrictions and aircraft delays adding pressure.

items.headline: SpiceJet's ₹5,500-cr fundraise: Can it revive the airline's operations?
items.summary: The proposed ₹5,500-crore raise follows a sharp drop in market share, grounded aircraft and unpaid dues, raising questions about whether fresh capital can restore SpiceJet's operations

items.headline: SpiceJet faces over 7,600 passenger complaints amid widespread flight cancellations
items.summary: SpiceJet faces 7,674 passenger complaints amid flight cancellations, DGCA scrutiny and a cash crunch as the airline operates around 10 aircraft.

items.headline: AI is giving hackers a head start. What's at risk for essential services?

items.headline: ‘Everyone is a friend’: Trump’s Asia meetings reveal contrasting approaches to world order
items.summary: The US President’s whirlwind Asia trip brought together rival geopolitical groupings, raising questions about Washington’s evolving approach to global power equations

items.headline: IndiGo expands Southeast Asia flights from Delhi ahead of year-end holidays

items.headline: India’s top 10 brands lose collective value as Airtel claims top spot, Meesho rises fastest
items.summary: In its annual ranking of India’s most valuable brands, Kantar said brand value of the top 10 fell collectively by 16%. Telecom provider Airtel claimed the top spot while value e-commerce platform Meesho rose the fastest to claim the 59th spot.
